description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for several different configurations of a large language model. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The first line, colored purple and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.65 at an iteration of 140000, with a steep initial decline followed by a more gradual decrease. The second line, colored orange and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.65 at an iteration of 140000, with a steep initial decline followed by a more gradual decrease. The third line, colored green and labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.55 at an iteration of 140000, with a steep initial decline followed by a more gradual decrease. The fourth line, colored red and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.55 at an iteration of 140000, with a steep initial decline followed by a more gradual decrease. The fifth line, colored blue and labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at an iteration of 140000, with a steep initial decline followed by a more gradual decrease.
